Written 'not published (the proposed process names a designated review period with no figure)', citing the July 7 minutes' list of what the proceeding would develop. The October 6, 2026 minutes, which this row cites for its status, adopt the review period with figures: Commission vote on each Petition, deemed approved if no vote within 90 days of filing (the July 8 proposal had sixty calendar days, p. 15), filing at least 120 days before the contract would become void, and best efforts to answer data requests within five business days (p. 16). By this dataset's own use of study_timeline for commission contract review (southern_florida-01, entergy-03) the value is published.
verdicts.corrected_value: Commission vote on each Petition to Contract, with no hearing or intervention; the Petition is deemed approved if the Commission fails to vote within 90 days from its filing; Alabama Power should file the Petition and Confidential Submission at least 120 days before the date the contract would become void for want of Commission approval; Alabama Power to use best efforts to answer Staff and Attorney General data requests within five business days
verdicts.words: AMENDED: DECISION AND REVIEW. Contracts submitted under this process shall be approved or disapproved through a Commission vote; however, if the Commission fails to vote within 90 days from the filing of the Petition, then the Petition is deemed approved. The process would not call for a hearing or intervention. ... However, Alabama Power should file the Petition and provide the Confidential Submission at least 120 days before the date the contract would become void for failing to meet the condition precedent of Commission approval.
